gloss: casual player; those who play for fun (slang)

definitions.gloss: casual player; those who play for fun
definitions.explanation: In gaming and hobby communities, people who take part casually for enjoyment rather than competing seriously — the counterpart of ガチ{勢|ぜい} (hardcore players).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This game has a lot of casual players.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガチ{勢|ぜい}→ガチ勢：06470_gachizei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Hardcore and casual players enjoy the game in different ways.

notes:
Formed from English "enjoy" plus the suffix ⟦{勢|ぜい}→〜勢：30490_zei⟧ (a group or faction of people). Labels people who join a game or hobby for fun, without chasing top results — the opposite of ⟦ガチ{勢|ぜい}→ガチ勢：06470_gachizei⟧.

REGISTER: Casual slang, common in gaming, fan, and hobby communities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy it as a casual player

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガチ{勢|ぜい}→ガチ勢：06470_gachizei⟧: hardcore players — those who play seriously and competitively
